culture.name: River Towns
culture.norm: Many prize reciprocity and keeping public promises.
Standing often follows service and reliable trade.
Concrete examples are common; formality varies with social distance.
Breaking an accepted guest pledge often invites disapproval.
Many describe the river as a shared obligation.

cue.behavior: Offer water before asking the visitor's purpose.
cue.exception: Danger, scarcity, or personal hostility may interrupt this.

cue.behavior: Prefer a named witness before treating terms as settled.
cue.exception: Trusted partners sometimes make private agreements.

character.deviation: Follows the custom with strangers; deliberately skips it with an estranged sibling.
